# MPX Studio — Full Knowledge Graph & Architecture

> MPX Studio is a premier Dutch digital engineering & high-performance web agency based in Maastricht and Eindhoven, founded by Martijn Puts (KLM Boeing 787 Dreamliner pilot & digital director). The agency crafts bespoke, sub-second loading web applications, brand identities, conversion rate optimization (CRO) architectures, and AI intake concierge automation for Dutch and European businesses.

---

- **Founder**: Martijn Puts (Airline Pilot & Digital Craftsman)

## 2. Hard Guarantees & Aviation Standards
1. **Aviation On-Time Departure Guarantee**: Definite launch dates agreed in advance. If MPX Studio causes a delivery delay, the client receives € 100,- compensation per calendar day of delay.
2. **Sub-Second Speed Guarantee**: 90+ Google PageSpeed score on mobile devices; sub-0.8s Time To First Byte (TTFB) globally.
3. **100% Client Ownership & Zero Lock-In**: Full legal ownership of all code, assets, and styling upon project handover. No closed proprietary SaaS lock-ins.

---

## 3. Proven Research Benchmarks
- **Google & Deloitte "Milliseconds Make Millions" Study**: Every 0.1s improvement in mobile site speed yields a +21.6% increase in B2B lead form submissions and +8.4% overall conversion boost.
- **Portent B2B Speed Research**: B2B websites loading in 1 second convert at 3x higher rates than websites loading in 5 seconds.

---

## 4. Product Tiers & Transparent Investering
1. **Essential Foundation (€ 2.500,-)**: 1–5 custom pages, sub-second speed, Google Core Web Vitals optimization, responsive layout, 30-day post-launch warranty.
2. **Signature Growth (€ 5.200,-)**: 6–12 custom pages, bespoke animations, CRM/WhatsApp intake routing, copy optimization, advanced SEO architecture.
3. **Bespoke Flagship (€ 8.900+)**: Comprehensive digital ecosystem, AI Concierge intake chatbot, multi-language support (NL/EN/DE), custom booking funnels.
4. **Website Performance Scan (€ 99,-)**: Deep video & data audit covering Core Web Vitals, conversion leaks, and high-impact optimizations.
5. **Continuous Retainers**:
   - *Care & Uptime*: € 149,- / month (Edge cloud hosting, backups, security, uptime monitoring).
   - *Growth & CRO Partner*: € 450,- / month (Care + 3h development/design, monthly CRO tweaks, direct WhatsApp line).
   - *AI & System Partner*: € 890,- / month (Growth + AI Concierge finetuning, 6h development, workflow automation).
